ligne-propos: English term in italics 17/600, acronym first when there is one; translation 17; in results, the first sentence of the definition 15 grey. The typed text is marked bold and underlined. The whole row is the target.
bracketed-definition: A bracketed passage has not been agreed yet: it is still under negotiation. Brackets are lifted one by one.
gga-definition: Paris Agreement goal raising adaptation to the level of mitigation. At COP30, the stake was adopting a hundred indicators.
rail-propos: 24 px column on the right edge, 26 letters 15/700, line height 20; the target extends to 44 px towards the content. Tap or slide to jump to a group; an empty letter is grey and leads to the next group; the current letter has a 3 px rule.
lie-propos: The filter pill, as a link: it opens the entry and toggles nothing.
loupe-propos: 44 px round button, left of “Aa”, on root screens: it opens global search.
groupe-propos: The global search groups its results by content, in the order Glossary, FAQ, Documents, Sessions. Name in capitals and a named count on the right; rows are each content's own, the query marked in bold underline; beyond five, a link leads to the rest in the content's screen.
feuille-terme-propos: The reader opens it when an italic English term is touched. It fills from the kept glossary, offline: family, term, translation, definition, pages of the document, “Open in the glossary”. When absent, it says so and offers to suggest it, in the “Suggest a term” sheet.
